cohort: Pregnant women, either with a history of bariatric surgery (n=49) or with obesity (BMI >= 30 kg/m2) without prior bariatric surgery (n=146).
finding: Prior bariatric surgery was associated with lower gestational diabetes mellitus incidence and lower neonatal birth weight compared to women with obesity without prior surgery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not show significant differences between the two groups.
